original_benchmark.notes: PHYBench releases 500 questions; only the 100 in PHYBench-fullques_v1.json have reference answers. Upstream provides the EED scorer but no inference harness (single LLM call, boxed answer, EED).

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on all 100 tasks, 3 runs per side. Original side: codex in a fork of phybench-official/phybench scored with upstream EED.
